maya: quick RFC follow-up 1: propose a compact "shadow-handshake" pattern for canary/A-B rollouts: tiny mirror -> warm namespace -> soft fallback.

raj: outline the phases?

maya: phase0: shadow mirror 0.5% (no user-visible output). phase1: warm 3-7% (responses returned, cache namespaced). phase2: ramp active; fallback allowed.

sasha: cache isolation is a must. use header `X-Variant` and `cache_ns=variant:<id>` so shadow warms separate keys. avoids pollution and false positives.

jamie: add synthetic priming jobs after phase0 to hit 95/99 seq lengths. warms runtimes and KV caches deterministically.

raj: what triggers fallback? simple heuristics: p95 latency and error rate. add hysteresis so canary gets time to stabilize.

maya: draft policy snippet: breach_window=60s, consecutive=3, cooldown=300s, min_warm=600s.

infra-bot: scheduled dry-run shadow for canary/2026-06-10T02:00Z.

jamie: cost guard idea: warm_pct gated by token_budget. if spend > budget, reduce warm_pct by X%. need dashboard hooks.

sasha: avoid feedback loop: when fallback triggers, mark variant "quarantined" and prevent immediate retries until cooldown.

maya: API contract: emit `canary_phase` metric and header `X-Fallback-Reason` when fallback occurs. clients can log & surface.

raj: ops runbook: panic toggle sets route=stable 100%, pins sessions if necessary, creates incident stub.

maya: action items: sasha protos cache_ns, jamie probe runner + dashboard mock, raj budget gating. infra-bot will run dry and collect telemetry. reconvene next week. :thumbsup:
